anomalies.description: Multiple players from both teams engage in a physical altercation near center ice, with referees intervening to separate them. The scuffle involves grappling, pushing, and at least one player on the ice being restrained by others.

A multi-player on-ice altercation involving players from both teams, with referees intervening to separate them. Players are seen grappling, pushing, and being restrained in a tight cluster near center ice throughout the sequence.; Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained physical altercation near the goal crease, involving grappling, shoving, and falling to the ice, with referees attempting to intervene.
A player in maroon (No. 18) appears to strike or push a downed opponent (in white/blue) while the opponent is on the ice and unable to defend themselves, amidst the ongoing scrum.

Multiple players from opposing teams (maroon vs. blue/white) engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the goal crease, involving grappling, pushing, and shoving; referees intervene throughout to separate combatants.

A player in maroon (likely the goalie or a fallen player) is on the ice and appears helpless while being struck or pinned by multiple opponents; one opponent in blue/white is seen delivering a punch or forceful blow to the downed player’s head/upper body at f4–f6.

A multi-player on-ice brawl erupts in front of the net, involving players from both teams (maroon and blue/white jerseys) and referees attempting to separate them. The fight includes grappling, pushing, and shoving, with players falling and being restrained over multiple seconds.; Multiple players from opposing teams (maroon vs. white/blue) engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the goal crease, involving grappling, shoving, and attempts to strike; referees and several non-uniformed individuals intervene to separate the combatants throughout the sequence.
Multiple players and individuals are engaged in mutual physical combat near the goal crease, with visible grappling, pushing, and attempts to strike; referees and others intervene to separate them.

A large group of players, officials, and non-uniformed individuals converge in a chaotic cluster near the net, with multiple simultaneous physical altercations, helmets on ice, and loss of game control—indicating collective violent unrest beyond a simple fight.

After initial separation, one individual in a tan jacket appears to strike or shove a downed or restrained player (in white jersey) while others hold him back; the targeted player is not actively resisting, suggesting a helpless victim.

A physical altercation occurs near the boards involving at least two individuals: one in a dark jacket and another in a patterned (possibly checkered) shirt, with a referee intervening. The individuals are seen grappling, pushing, and making contact; the person in the patterned shirt is restrained by the referee and another individual while the confrontation continues.

During the ongoing scuffle, the individual in the dark jacket appears to strike or shove the person in the patterned shirt who is partially restrained and off-balance against the glass, suggesting an attack on a temporarily helpless victim.
